india_read_through: Nothing confirmed as scheduled for India or Asia inside Nifty hours, so event risk during the session is mostly unscheduled or headline-driven. The main overhang is the US midterm outcome (vote Nov 3 US time, results flowing into Asian hours). A divided Congress or gridlock has historically been mildly risk-positive for equities; a surprise wave outcome that lifts US yields or the dollar would be negative for Nifty via FPI flows and INR. US ADP (about 18:45 IST) and ISM services (about 20:30 IST) land after the close and could set up Thursday's gap: a strong print would raise US yields and the dollar (negative for Nifty), a weak print would help. BoE decision Nov 5 (hike to 4% expected) and US NFP Nov 6 are later-week risks that may make traders cautious.
